assignment.fastQualifier: Fast was requested; separate service-tier control was not exposed. No distinct Fast tier is asserted.

accessBoundary.mechanism: Instruction-only restriction in a shared executor

readAccounting.sixInputFiles: First read all six as text; imports.json reread for unchanged import construction; all six reread as bytes for accounting.
readAccounting.ownSource: Read authored attachments.ts to make sequential await-then-push explicit and for output accounting.
readAccounting.ownReceipt: Read authored author-record.json for complete read-path accounting and final receipt byte/hash/mode accounting.

authorRecord.sha256Location: Reported separately to the parent and in the final response; a receipt cannot contain its own ordinary SHA256 digest without recursive self-reference.

retainedExpression.statement: Exact existing protocol/schema/fields/prose/constants/format/evaluation material is required retained expression. No new grant or cosmetic novelty claim is made.
details: Unchanged imports and public reexports; public options and exported functions.
Fallback attachment names; MIME strings; error codes; reason strings; storage and recoverability values.
Metadata and content block fields, own optional/undefined properties, nullish and truthy semantics, spread behavior, Buffer.byteLength calls and getter observation order.
READ_DEFAULT_MAX_LINES and READ_MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES owners and strict oversized boundary.
Port stat receiver and request/operation argument shapes; delegated collaborator ownership.

chosenStructure.summary: Public metadata summary and sequential collection loop; private single-item dispatcher; private inline resolver; private local text resolver.
chosenStructure.rationale: Dispatch gates are grouped in one owner operation. Inline media fallback and local file admission each retain their own evaluation and exception boundary.

contractCoverage.eventSummary: No I/O; native map preserves holes; path captured; filename/header/MIME/bytes/ref priority retained; truthy ref only.
contractCoverage.sequence: Fresh result array; entries iterator; each resolution awaited into a local before push and next; sparse element property failures retained.
contractCoverage.url: URL dispatch precedes every other gate and preserves empty strings; no inline/local/store call.
contractCoverage.pdfAdmission: Truthy plain PDF content returns attachment_pdf_invalid placeholder using original attachment and required PDF options.
contractCoverage.inlineAdmission: Plain nonimage content delegates unchanged inline-text helper; data/artifact reading delegates unchanged collaborator; failed reading does not fall through; new spread objects preserve caller input.
contractCoverage.inlineFallback: Header condition and content reread; media collaborator always awaited; truthy result exact; separate byteLength calls and required fields preserved.
contractCoverage.localAdmission: Captured port passed through options spread; media types delegate unchanged; local path/source construction before try.
contractCoverage.binaryClipboard: Binary path-reference branch precedes clipboard-text branch; neither calls text reader; no restoring clipboard body to prompt attachment.
contractCoverage.localRead: Method receiver retained for stat; strict oversized comparison and conditional options only; no added authority, fs, storage, cache or resolver validation.
contractCoverage.localSuccess: Direct live read-property evaluation; metadata field order; defined false/zero/empty optionals; own undefined startLine and totalLines.
contractCoverage.localCatch: Catch covers stat/read/reference/success construction including abort; initial path/source errors escape; failed-placeholder errors escape; failure options omit sizeBytes.

verification.method: Manual review against the six frozen declaration/contract inputs and authored source only. Byte/hash/line/mode accounting only.

cooperativeFreeze.claim: Cooperative permission freeze only; no OS isolation or access-audit claim.
